summary: Obsidian's Eora-set isometric RPG series, with PC complete/ultimate editions as the highest-fidelity routes and console ports documented separately.

entries.title: Pillars of Eternity
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release with The White March Part I and Part II

primary.version: Pillars of Eternity PC release with The White March
primary.why: The Windows release is the original, highest-fidelity CRPG route and supports the complete game plus both parts of The White March expansion. Console Complete Editions bundle the expansions but do not add exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release with The White March Part I and Part II installed; use console Complete Edition only if controller/couch play is required.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Complete Edition bundles the expansions, but the PC route remains the archive recommendation.

entries.title: Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire
entries.definitive_edition: Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire Ultimate Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with all DLC installed.

primary.version: Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire Ultimate Edition PC release
primary.why: Windows is the original and highest-fidelity route, and the Ultimate/complete PC content set includes the expansion material. PS4/Xbox One Ultimate Edition is complete but not higher fidelity; the Switch version was cancelled.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release with all DLC/Ultimate Edition content installed through Steam/GOG.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Ultimate Edition is complete but not preferred for archive fidelity; no Switch release shipped.
